page.layout: One scanned image: a photograph of a book's closed fore-edge (the stacked page edges between two leather boards), set on a black band. Below it, a digitiser's credit block in small white type. No printed text block.
page.notes: The scan shows only the closed fore-edge of a book with reddish-stained page edges and leather boards; no printed text is visible. The small white credit lines at the lower left ("Early European Books, Copyright © 2011 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of Koninklijke Bibliotheek, Den Haag. 36 G 23 [1]") are the digitiser's cover block and are left out.
